fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location where the autoscaling policy should reside.

fields.label: Graceful Decommission Timeout
fields.help: Timeout for YARN graceful decommissioning of Node Managers.

fields.label: Scale Down Factor
fields.help: Fraction of average pending memory in the last cooldown period for which to remove workers.

fields.label: Scale Down Min Worker Fraction
fields.help: Minimum scale-down threshold as a fraction of total cluster size before scaling occurs.

fields.label: Scale Up Factor
fields.help: Fraction of average pending memory in the last cooldown period for which to add workers.

fields.label: Scale Up Min Worker Fraction
fields.help: Minimum scale-up threshold as a fraction of total cluster size before scaling occurs.

fields.label: Secondary Worker Config
Max Instances
fields.help: Maximum number of instances for this group.

fields.label: Min Instances
fields.help: Minimum number of instances for this group.

fields.label: Weight
fields.help: Weight for the instance group, which is used to determine the fraction of total workers in the cluster from this instance group.
Describes how the autoscaler will operate for secondary workers.
